results.summary: This design detects the tempo (BPM) of a live audio stream entirely in hardware using onset detection and a bit-serial divider. It receives 8-bit unsigned audio amplitude samples with a sample_valid strobe and outputs a latched BPM estimate, beat pulse, tempo-locked, confidence, and overflow flags. The onset detector uses a shift-based IIR envelope and refractory window, and the tempo estimator averages the last four intervals. The BPM divider computes bpm = 6000 / interval_samples using a 13-cycle bit-serial restoring divider, with no CPU or multiplier.
